subject: SIG: request for access control inventory and SCIM evidence
messages:
From: Tim Baxter <tbaxter@voltcare.net>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: access control inventory and delegation

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is working through the SIG and we have a few focused asks on access controls before the legal review can proceed: 

- A CSV export (or role matrix) showing all IAM roles, associated permissions, and current principals (users/groups/service accounts).
- SCIM provisioning evidence: examples of a user create/update/delete and the sync log for the last 30 days (delta is OK).
- SAML/SSO metadata and confirmation of IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flows.
- MFA enforcement summary: which principals are in scope (admin/service accounts/contractors) and policy snapshot.
- Short justification for any service accounts with broad access (least-privilege rationale).

Would you be able to provide the CSV and at least a first-pass evidence package by COB Friday (Aug 13)? I attached the SIG worksheet the team prefers for mapping answers.

Thanks,
Tim
Security Operations 
VoltCare Health

Attachment: voltcare_SIG_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG follow-up: access control inventory and delegation

Team — forwarding VoltCare's access-specific ask. Key deliverables and owners I propose: 

- Role matrix export (role_inventory.csv) — owner: Marissa 
- SCIM sync logs (30d delta; redacted PII) — owner: Kimberly
- SAML metadata + flow doc (saml-metadata.xml + short note) — owner: Rachel
- MFA policy snapshot + scope explanation (mfa_policy_snapshot.pdf) — owner: Aditya
- Service account justification notes (one-pager) — collective, compiled by me

Timeline: VoltCare requested COB Fri Aug 13. I think we can get a first-pass package by EOD Thu Aug 12 if owners can prioritize. We should avoid including any live PII in logs; provide redacted examples and a description of the normal retention/rotation process.

Action items: please confirm you can take the owner tasks and call out any blockers by 10:30 AM PT today. If needed, we can ask VoltCare for a two-business-day extension.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: security@voltcare.net
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG follow-up: access control inventory and delegation

Rachel / team,

Thanks for the quick response. A couple of clarifications from our side that will help reduce back-and-forth: 

- For the role matrix, we need a mapping to your internal role IDs (if any) and to high-level permissions (read/write/admin) rather than raw policy blobs.
- SCIM logs: a zipped set of delta logs for July would be ideal; please redact email addresses if that reduces friction.
- For service accounts, please surface any long-lived keys and whether those keys are rotated automatically. If you have a short justification doc for each long-lived account, that will work.
- If you expect it will take longer than Aug 13 for complete logs, please send what you have by Aug 12 and indicate outstanding items.

We can accept the evidence package as a single ZIP or as individual attachments. We prefer a Google Drive link if the ZIP exceeds mailbox limits.

Best,
The VoltCare Security Team
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tim Baxter <tbaxter@voltcare.net>, security@voltcare.net
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG follow-up: access control inventory and delegation

Tim / VoltCare security team — attaching our initial evidence bundle and a short notes readme. Per your ask we included a role matrix mapped to role IDs and a permissions summary, SCIM delta logs for July (redacted), SAML metadata, and an MFA policy snapshot. Outstanding items:

- A few service-account justification write-ups are still in review (expect final by Aug 16).
- A complete key-rotation audit (long-lived keys) is queued with Infra; ETA Aug 17.

Attachments: sig_evidence_package_v1.zip (contains role_inventory.csv, scim_sync_logs_202707.zip, saml-metadata.xml, mfa_policy_snapshot.pdf, README_SIG_v1.md)

Quick summary of contents: 
- role_inventory.csv — columns: role_id, role_name, permission_summary, current_principals_count, example_principals (redacted)
- scim_sync_logs_202707.zip — delta entries July 1–31; addresses create/update/delete activity for SCIM-enabled groups; email addresses redacted per policy
- saml-metadata.xml — SP metadata and IdP endpoints; indicates IdP-initiated is disabled for most flows except partner onboarding
- mfa_policy_snapshot.pdf — shows enforcement for all human users; service accounts excluded and logged separately

If VoltCare prefers Drive access to the unzipped evidence, I can share a secure folder link and set expiration. Let me know if you'd like a short walkthrough call — happy to join a 30-minute review.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Forwarded message included for context.
